facts.fact: Socialnetlink states Cote d'Ivoire's law promoting digital startups (Loi n° 2023-901) was adopted on 23 November 2023, setting up a national label and incentives.
facts.system: Loi n° 2023-901 on digital startups (Startup Act)

note: No count of labelled startups and no investments by a public fund are stated; the 1.05bn FCFA programme and the 100bn fund are agreements or announcements.
